# Factions & Organizations

## Abernethys {#abernethys}

The Abernethys are a family that resides at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), a sprawling, isolated house situated at the edge of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Aid Society {#aid-society}

The Church Aid Society is a church-affiliated organization in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) that counts Mrs. Agatha Sowerby as a primary pillar.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Aids {#aids}

The [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society), or the Aids, is a community organization whose members gather for afternoon meetings and tea, with attendees including Mrs. Jasper Bell.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P41](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0041), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P42](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0042), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), +7 more_

## Ainslies {#ainslies}

The Ainslies were a family whose members included [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), her brother [Julian](../character/julian.md), her mother Rose, and her father Frank, who held a heavily mortgaged farm.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P23](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P25](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0025), +5 more_

## Americans {#americans}

Americans are summer visitors who consider the coast ideal and frequent the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Conservative {#conservative}

The Conservatives, also referred to as Tories, are a [Canadian](../codex/places.md#canadian) political party that held power for eighteen years prior to being ousted in a election by the Liberals.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P31](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0031), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P32](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P33](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0033), +16 more_

**Members:** [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)

## Cottons {#cottons}

The Cottons are a family including young Pete, Tommy, Adolphus, [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), their mother, and elder sisters, who live in a house backed by a forest stream and are described as loud, daring, and semi-savage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P29](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0029), [v3 ch.Transgressors P30](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0030), [v3 ch.Transgressors P31](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0031), [v3 ch.Transgressors P32](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0032), +16 more_

## Crawfords {#crawfords}

The Crawfords are a family and political faction residing across the harbor from [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), associated in a local proverb with vainglory.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P29](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0029), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P30](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P31](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0031), +14 more_

## Debating Club {#debating-club}

The Debating Club, also known as the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Debating Club, is an organization that meets biweekly throughout the winter, hosts minor free entertainments, and organizes paid concerts featuring speeches, declamations, and choir performances to raise funds for its library.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P5](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P6](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## Ducketts {#ducketts}

The Ducketts are a family residing in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) who took in Mrs. Elisha Duckett's impoverished and solitary aunt, [Aunt Drusilla](../character/aunt-drusilla.md), following the death of her husband.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P14](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0014), [v3 ch.Life P15](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0015), [v3 ch.Life P16](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0016), [v3 ch.Life P17](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0017), +14 more_

## Eaton {#eaton}

_Not yet known._

## Fairlies {#fairlies}

The Fairlies are a family who provided half of the pastor Mr. Leavitt's stipend and threatened to leave his congregation if an evangelist preacher remained in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P4](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P5](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P6](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007), +5 more_

## Gardners {#gardners}

The Gardners are among the wealthiest and most elite of the Bluenoses residing in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043), [v3 ch.Charming P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 ch.Charming P45](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0045), [v3 ch.Charming P46](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0046), +5 more_

## Grit {#grit}

The Grits, also associated with the Liberals, are a political party opposing the [Conservatives](../codex/factions.md#conservative) or Tories.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P33](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0033), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P0](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P1](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P2](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0002), +19 more_

## Improvers {#improvers}

The Improvers, also known as the B.V.I.S., are members of a thriving village improvement society who work to enhance the local area by planting grass and trees, adding floral arrangements, and petitioning to maintain community aesthetics.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P29](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0029), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P32](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0032), +30 more_

## Kerrs {#kerrs}

The Kerrs are a numerous and obstinate family residing across the harbor from [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) who are known for their conceit and deeply rooted political convictions.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P29](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0029), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P30](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P31](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0031), +14 more_

## Liberal {#liberal}

The Liberals are a political party whose members include [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), old Martin Bovyer, and Isolde's father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## MacAllisters {#macallisters}

The MacAllisters are a numerous group of people residing in a dense settlement on the far side of the harbor from [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), noted in a local proverb for their pride.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P27](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P29](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0029), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P30](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0030), +6 more_

## Methodist {#methodist}

The Methodists are a religious denomination with a local church led by a minister, noted for having a fine choir and for allowing women to preach.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P12](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P13](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P14](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P15](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0015), +24 more_

**Members:** [Fiske](../character/fiske.md), [Stroud](../character/stroud.md)

## Presbyterian {#presbyterian}

The Presbyterians are a Christian religious denomination with its own church, distinct from the [Methodists](../codex/factions.md#methodist), whose members include adherents like Miss Winifred that prioritize patronizing fellow Presbyterians.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P28](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P29](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0029), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P30](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0030), +12 more_

## Story Club {#story-club}

The Story Club was an association formed during their school years by Isolde, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), and [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), in which they composed exciting tales.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P39](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0039), [v3 ch.Life P40](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0040), [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), +14 more_

## Tulks {#tulks}

The Tulks are a family from [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford)—including Roger and the taciturn painter Joshua—who drew the community's ire after painting a hall an unsightly bright blue due to a mix-up over the ordered color number.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P23](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0023), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P26](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0026), +18 more_

## Yankee {#yankee}

"Yankee" is a term used for people from the United States, against whom individuals like Mrs. Agatha harbor strong personal biases.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P44](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0044), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), +6 more_
